descriptionChirho: Piel active: to command or order someone with authority, to lay a charge upon, to give instructions or directives (Arabic amara/awsa); covers all persons, numbers, tenses, and conjugations of the active Piel.
Piel: to appoint or commission someone to a role or task, to designate or establish in a position (Arabic aqama 'establish', ayyina 'appoint'; Hindi niyukt karna 'to appoint').
Piel participle used substantivally as a title: a commander, leader, or one who gives orders (Arabic amiran; Spanish gobernante 'ruler').

Piel: to send word or dispatch a command/message, emphasizing the act of sending or commissioning rather than the authority of the command itself (Arabic arsalu 'they sent'; Hindi sandesh bheja 'sent a message').
Pual passive: to be commanded, to receive a command or be under orders (Arabic umira/umirtu 'was commanded'; Korean myeongnyeong-badda 'receive a command').
